snippet.title: Aggregator Elevator System - Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Challenge your logic and strategy in new ways in this number-based tile-placement puzzle game! Master a rich system of logical rules where you must arrange blocks within a grid to make all the numbers add up correctly. 

Try the demo : https://store.steampowered.com/app/2226610/Aggregator_Elevator_System/
